# Overlay `cards/` (v1.0 slice OC, object cards and property icons)

Synthetic overlay for `docs/acceptance/cards.md` (FR-TYP-11 AC-5…AC-29, FR-TYP-01 AC-12…AC-21, FR-TYP-12 AC-4, FR-LNK-14 AC-15, AR-07 AC-11, FR-FMT-07 AC-36, FR-FMT-12 AC-15, FR-SYN-02 AC-14, FR-SYN-03 AC-35, FR-SYN-06 AC-51, FR-STO-07 AC-15, NFR-POR-01 AC-7, FR-UX-03 AC-54, AC-55, FR-UX-08 AC-26, FR-UX-05 AC-26, NFR-OTH-02 AC-24), `docs/acceptance/types.md` (FR-TYP-01 AC-22…AC-28, FR-EDT-07 AC-22), `docs/acceptance/views.md` part four (FR-QRY-05 AC-30), `docs/acceptance/embeds.md` (FR-EMB-02 AC-19…AC-21) and `docs/acceptance/previews.md` part four (FR-LNK-10 AC-18). Hand-written (D-50); every name, title, value and text is invented (D-62). **Nothing here comes from board `CardSettings` sections C and D**, which hold the owner's own data (D-2074, D-2171). **Status: draft**, written with the criteria; AP-1571…AP-1604 may change what a criterion expects from these files, not the files themselves.

**How tests use it.** A test copies `tests/fixtures/vaults/views/` (without its README), then `tests/fixtures/vaults/new-empty/.tegg/`, then this folder (without this README). This folder **adds** files only; it replaces none (`views/`'s `.tegg/types/` holds `book.yml` and `autor.yml`, new-empty's the seven system types, this folder `výlet.yml`, `článek.yml`, `kontrola.yml`). `book.yml` and `autor.yml` stay without `card:`, so they are the "type without `card:`" cases (D-2059). There is no `ui-state.json`; tests that need one write it.

**Byte rules.** LF, UTF-8 without BOM, every file ends with one `\n`, NFC everywhere (file names and content). Ids are `01JBCD` + 20 characters (`01JBCD00000000000000000001`…`…0042`, ULID alphabet), one per file. Time stamps carry the Europe/Prague offset of their date (`+02:00` until 25 October 2026, `+01:00` after). Don't open and re-save these files in an editor; the `—` (U+2014) values are deliberate. NFD, CRLF and no-final-newline variants are made at runtime.

**Test clock** (cards.md): `2026-11-19T10:00:00+01:00` (a Thursday), Europe/Prague, region `en-US`, Date & time setting `Region`; `(TZ)` criteria also `America/Los_Angeles`. Expected cards at that clock: cards.md R218.

| `článek.yml` | Článek / Články, folder `Články`, icon `newspaper` (a Lucide name that isn't one of the 24 old names), orange | **`review: true`**; `card: [body, rubrika, source, created]` on line 10; **no `preview` key**; `rubrika` Select Cestování / Příroda **without icon** | the review workflow's `Unreviewed` pill (FR-TYP-12 AC-4); `body` text; `source` as a URL, a `file://` folder, a wikilink and plain text (FR-TYP-11 AC-12, AC-13); a Select pill without icon (AC-10) |
| `kontrola.yml` | Kontrola / Kontroly, folder `Kontroly`, **icon `check-square`** (the old name Lucide 0.460 calls `square-check-big`, D-2067), green | **no `card:` and no `preview:`**; `výsledek` Checkbox | the default list without preview keys, `tags, body, modified` (FR-TYP-11 AC-5); the alias (FR-TYP-01 AC-19, FR-TYP-11 AC-16); `card:` inserted after `review:` (AC-21 (d)); `false` draws nothing (AC-8) |

## Made at runtime by the tests (never committed)

- **Attachments:** `_attachments/vyhlidka.png`, a copy of `tests/fixtures/vaults/trash-media/_attachments/záhon.png` (64 × 48 PNG, 1,234 bytes), and `_attachments/pravidla-tabora.pdf`, a copy of `tests/fixtures/vaults/trash-media/_attachments/Rozpočet.pdf` (2 pages, 844 bytes), so the objects' `size`, `width`, `height` and `pages` are true. FR-TYP-11 AC-15 also removes the PNG.
- **`card:` variants of `výlet.yml`:** `card: []`; `[title, kraj]`; `[tags, tags, title, kraj]`; an NFD `kraj`; a block list; `card: tags` (scalar) and `card: { a: b }` (mapping); `[description, body, stav]` and `[body, description]`; `[created, modified]`; `[tags, kraj]` with a trailing comment `   # karta`; CRLF and no-final-newline copies; no `card:` (the default from `preview`); `version: 2`.
- **Other type variants:** `book.yml` with `preview: [tags, modified, neznámý, author]`, with `preview: []`, without `preview`, with `card: [tags, kraj]` written by another program; `kontrola.yml` with `card: [výsledek]` and with `icon: neexistuje`; `článek.yml` with `card: [rubrika, aliases, source, created]`; `průvodce` with `multiple: true`; a type `prázdný` (Name `Prázdný`, plural `Prázdné`) with no objects; a property named `Map` (Suggested icons); five Text attributes `a1`…`a5` on the NFR-PERF-07 AC-6 type `karta`; an osoba-like type file without `version`; a vault without `.tegg/types/task.yml`.
- **Object variants:** Sněžka with `kraj: " — "`, `"–"`, `"-"`, `"— nic"`, a 200-character `kraj`, a 600-character description, no description, `vybavení: [Mapa, —]` and `[—]`, `modified: 2026-11-18T23:30:00Z`, `icon: rocket` and `cover: "[[vyhlidka.png]]"`, `průvodce: ["[[Eva Lindová]]", "[[Marek Sova]]"]`; Kontrola with `výsledek: false`; Chaty with 12 aliases; sources `https://example.cz/m%C3%ADsta/Sn%C4%9B%C5%BEka/`, `file:///Users/test/Dokumenty/mapa-krkonos.pdf`, `javascript:alert(1)`; `odkaz: example.org`; a Page `Sněžka z Pece` (a duplicate title, FR-LNK-14 AC-15); a note linking `[[Sněžka z Pece]]` for its preview; NFD copies of keys and tags.
- **Settings:** `tests/fixtures/settings/controls-0.5.json` is recorded once from the 0.5.x build (app-shell.md FR-UX-02 AC-24) and committed by the test author with a `Fixture-Change:` trailer; it isn't part of this overlay.
- `ui-state.json` with `recentIcons`, and a 0.5.x one without it (FR-STO-07 AC-15).
